outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental protocol, not a data plot.
Panel B shows raw western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.

These are line graphs of mean ± SEM (n = 3–4 independent experiments) for marker gene expression over time; only the averages with error bars are shown, with no individual replicate data points overlaid.
Panel D consists of live-imaging micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
These are flow cytometry dot plots where each point represents an individual cell; the raw single-cell data are displayed directly, not an average summary.
Line graph of mean ± SEM percent positive cells (n = 3–4) across conditions; individual biological replicate values are not shown.
Line graph of mean ± SEM percent positive cells (n = 3–4) across conditions; individual biological replicate values are not shown.
Panel H shows immunostaining micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.

Tukey boxplots summarizing RNA-seq quantifications across only n = 3 biological replicates; no individual data points are overlaid on the boxplots despite the very low sample size, which would be important to show spread/variability.
The heatmap displays individual sample/replicate columns (log2FC values per sample) rather than an averaged summary statistic, so the underlying individual values are already visible.
